_about: The session debrief form (JP-113). The kinds and endings are in codes.json (debrief_kinds, debrief_ended_how). status is provisional until `python3 ledger/debrief.py finalise-form` has run on at least two weeks of real friction-fact rows; it then records the final lists and that date range in `final` and moves form_version from 1-provisional to 1. friction_thresholds say when a session's facts show friction (an episode earns a debrief when any fact reaches its number); they are starting values, and Josh may edit them.
